events.address: Century 21 NYC, 22 Cortlandt St, New York, NY 10007
events.what_it_is: A two-day public Fashion Week activation on Century 21's main floor where anyone can walk a runway and be filmed for the store's social stories.
events.what_is_free: Runway participation plus one Century 21 tote, up to five iron-on patches and a $21-off-$100 in-store card per walker, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Official Century 21 source says no ticket, invitation or online sign-up is required. Totes and patches are while supplies last. Walking the runway includes being filmed for Century 21 social stories.
events.practical_notes: Enter on the Dey Street side and get in line at the main-floor runway station. Official source says the line and giveaway supply are best around noon.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A branded SoHo truck celebrating eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments on the final day of NYFW.
events.what_is_free: Dewy Lip Shine product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments while supplies last.
events.caveats: Current NYC event sources agree the activation is open to the public from noon to 5 PM. Product/sweet-treat availability is while supplies last. No RSVP requirement is published in the corroborating listings.
events.practical_notes: Branded truck at 575 Broadway in SoHo. Arriving earlier is prudent for samples because the listing specifies while-supplies-last availability.

events.event_name: Mary Kay — Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: An oversized public beauty experience at Gansevoort Plaza tied to Mary Kay's Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared campaign, with touch-ups and interactive/photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Full-size Mary Kay products, beauty touch-ups and interactive/photo moments are advertised as free.
events.caveats: Multiple current listings describe the activation as open to the public and free. A separate aggregator offers a free RSVP, but open-public language is explicit; RSVP is therefore treated as optional rather than approval-controlled admission.
events.practical_notes: Gansevoort Plaza in the Meatpacking District, noon–7 PM. Free product quantities are not guaranteed, so earlier arrival is safer.
